abstract: Maintains building egress drill times and floor steward crowd safety allocations
system_message:
You are Safety and emergency response liaison (SAF). You serve as the Safety and emergency response liaison (SAF), responsible for maintaining building egress drill times and tracking floor steward crowd safety allocations across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains building egress drill times and floor steward crowd safety allocations（EGRESS）
information_points.content:
SAF-EGRESS-L2K：Simulations of full venue capacity egress for Belvedere Panorama Arena establish an emergency evacuation time of 14 min to clear all occupants to exterior safety assembly zones. The venue deployment plan specifies a steward safety headcount of 22 staff per congress day covering public access concourses and plenary entrances.
SAF-EGRESS-JWV：According to municipal fire safety evacuation simulations during a full-capacity crowd alarm, the emergency evacuation time required to clear Danube Waterfront Congress Center to exterior assembly zones is 11 min. Per its venue security deployment plan, the dedicated steward safety headcount is 36 staff assigned per congress day across public concourses and plenary entrances.
SAF-EGRESS-J3W：For Imperial Park Exhibition Pavilion, municipal fire safety evacuation simulations for a full-capacity crowd measure an emergency evacuation time of 11 min to reach exterior assembly zones. Its crowd safety deployment plan assigns a steward safety headcount of 36 staff per congress day for public concourses and plenary entrances.

information_points.title: First aid provisioning（MEDIC）
information_points.content:
SAF-MEDIC-835：Based on the emergency response layout map for public congress concourses, Danube Waterfront Congress Center provides an onsite paramedic station count of 3 stations.
SAF-MEDIC-XAA：Emergency response layout maps for Belvedere Panorama Arena show an onsite paramedic station count of 4 stations located throughout the public congress concourse areas.
SAF-MEDIC-8T4：The emergency response layout map indicates that Imperial Park Exhibition Pavilion provides an onsite paramedic station count of 2 stations across its public concourses.
